svg.text: DIAGRAMS FROM THE PLAN DATA, to scale. The yards are v2's (36 m: the largest planned fort fits, checked); the market lanes are 20 m (v2: 28 m).
Green dots: front gates (on the market lanes); blue: rear gates (to the ring road, a crossing, and that fort's own starter shop 5 s away). Dotted: each front gate's view of the board.
Stalls on the square's corners: each is straight down two lanes, so from any front gate you see the board and two stalls. The yards look EMPTY at cycle 1 (A): see the proposal.
